logp.method_description: The experimental n-octanol/water partition coefficient (LogPo/w) was determined using the shake flask method. Compounds were first dissolved in small amount of DMSO and mixed with two phases of n-octanol (20 ml) and water (20 ml) of in a centrifuge tube. Then the two phases were mixed by vortexing for 30 min. The mixtures were left on a shaker overnight at ambient temperature to reach equilibrium and then were allowed to separate on standing. The amount of Ag in the aqueous phase was determined using Shimadzu ICP-OES 9820. The partition coefficients were calculated using Equation 1.
